json_patch.value: Fix: [wrangler] Ignore .wrangler writes in the dev assets watcher. Target files: .changeset/ignore-dev-assets-wrangler-dir.md, packages/wrangler/src/__tests__/api/startDevWorker/BundlerController.assets-watcher.test.ts, packages/wrangler/src/api/startDevWorker/BundlerController.ts. `wrangler dev` reloads in a loop when `assets.directory` is the project root, because the assets watcher treats the dev session's own `.wrangler` writes as asset changes.
